sources.schema: strabofield_spot.schema.json (title: StraboField Spot, generated from StraboField app forms Apr 2026)

fields.name: date
fields.label: Date
fields.hint: ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD); defaults to import date when blank on create

fields.name: strike
fields.label: Strike
fields.hint: Azimuth in degrees

fields.name: dip_direction
fields.label: Azimuth Dip Direction
fields.hint: Bulk convert strikes to dip directions from Home Menu -> Miscellaneous.

fields.name: quality
fields.label: Planar Measurement Quality
fields.hint: How well was this plane exposed or measured?

fields.name: feature_type
fields.label: Planar Feature Type
fields.hint: Type of planar geologic feature: e.g., bedding, contact, foliation, fracture, vein, shear zone

fields.name: bedding_type
fields.label: Bedding Type
fields.hint: Bedding defined by? change in lithology or sedimentary feature

fields.name: contact_type
fields.label: Contact Type
fields.hint: Specific contacts types under depositional, igneous and metamorphic

fields.name: foliation_type
fields.label: Foliation Type
fields.hint: Specific type of foliation defined by planar and/or linear elements

fields.name: fracture_type
fields.label: Fracture Type
fields.hint: Specific type of fracture: e.g., joint, shear or others

fields.name: vein_type
fields.label: Vein Type
fields.hint: Specific type: e.g., antitaxial, syntaxial, normal, oblique

fields.name: vein_fill
fields.label: Vein Mineral Fill
fields.hint: Mineral filling veins: calcite, quartz or other

fields.name: fault_or_sz_type
fields.label: Type of Fault or Shear Zone Boundary
fields.hint: Specific type: e.g., dextral, sinistral, normal, reverse, oblique

fields.name: other_fault_or_sz_type
fields.label: Other Fault or Shear Zone Boundary Type

fields.name: movement
fields.label: Movement
fields.hint: Relative movement across structure

fields.name: movement_justification
fields.label: Movement Justification
fields.hint: Offset feature types used to determine relative movement

fields.name: directional_indicators
fields.label: Directional Indicators
fields.hint: Specific sense of shear indicator, such as Riedel shears, S-C fabrics, drag folds, etc.

fields.name: movement_amount_m
fields.label: Movement Amount (m)
fields.hint: How much movement?

fields.name: facing
fields.label: Plane Facing
fields.hint: Orientation of plane relative to original position e.g., upright, overturned, vertical

fields.name: facing_defined_by
fields.label: Plane Facing Defined By
fields.hint: Criteria for facing direction: e.g., stratigraphy, facing indicators, other

fields.name: trend
fields.label: Trend
fields.hint: Azimuth in degrees

fields.name: rake
fields.label: Rake
fields.hint: down dip angle from strike on plane (0-180)?

fields.name: vorticity
fields.label: Vorticity Type
fields.hint: Clockwise or counterclockwise looking down plunge

fields.name: fault_or_sz
fields.label: Fault Zone or Shear Zone Type

fields.name: other_fault_or_sz
fields.label: Other Fault Zone or Shear Zone Type

fields.name: rock_type
fields.label: Rock Type
fields.hint: Type: sedimentary, igneous, metamorphic, or sediment

fields.name: sediment_type
fields.label: Sediment Type
fields.hint: Specific type of sediment

fields.name: sedimentary_rock_type
fields.label: Sedimentary Rock Type
fields.hint: Specific type of sedimentary rock

fields.name: igneous_rock_class
fields.label: Igneous Rock Class
fields.hint: Volcanic, hypabyssal or plutonic

fields.name: volcanic_rock_type
fields.label: Volcanic Rock Type
fields.hint: Specific volcanic rock type

fields.name: plutonic_rock_types
fields.label: Plutonic Rock Types
fields.hint: Specific plutonic rock type

fields.name: metamorphic_rock_types
fields.label: Metamorphic Rock Types
fields.hint: Specific metamorphic rock type

fields.name: metamorphic_grade
fields.label: Metamorphic Grade
fields.hint: Specific metamorphic grade

fields.name: eon
fields.label: Eon
fields.hint: Specific geologic time eon

fields.name: period_cenozoic
fields.label: Period Cenozoic
fields.hint: Specific geologic time period

fields.name: period_mesozoic
fields.label: Period Mesozoic
fields.hint: Specific geologic time period

fields.name: period_paleozoic
fields.label: Period Paleozoic
fields.hint: Specific geologic time period

fields.name: period_neoproterozoic
fields.label: Period Neoproterozoic
fields.hint: Specific geologic time period

fields.name: period_mesoproterozoic
fields.label: Period Mesoproterozoic
fields.hint: Specific geologic time period

fields.name: period_paleoproterozoic
fields.label: Period Paleoproterozoic
fields.hint: Specific geologic time period

fields.name: age_modifier
fields.label: Age Modifier
fields.hint: Age modifier to era, period or epoch

fields.name: max_absolute_age_of_geol_unit
fields.label: Maximum Absolute Age of Geologic Unit (Ma)

fields.name: min_absolute_age_of_geol_unit
fields.label: Minimum Absolute Age of Geologic Unit (Ma)

fields.name: other_metamorphic_grade
fields.label: Other Metamorphic Grade
fields.hint: metamorphic grade not given in list

fields.name: trace_quality
fields.label: Trace Quality
fields.hint: Quality of trace? Known, approximate, inferred, concealed, questioned

fields.name: trace_type
fields.label: Trace Type
fields.hint: contact (unconformity), structure (fault), geomorphic, anthropogenic, other

fields.name: contact_type
fields.label: Contact Type
fields.hint: depositional, metamorphic, igneous, marker, other

fields.name: depositional_contact_type
fields.label: Depositional Contact Type
fields.hint: stratigraphic, alluvial, unconformities

fields.name: intrusive_contact_type
fields.label: Intrusive Contact Type
fields.hint: dike, sill, pluton, migmatite, injectite

fields.name: metamorphic_contact_type
fields.label: Metamorphic Contact Type
fields.hint: between layers, isograd, other

fields.name: geologic_structure_type
fields.label: Geologic Structure Type
fields.hint: fault, shear zone, axial trace

fields.name: shear_sense
fields.label: Shear Sense
fields.hint: dextral, sinistral, normal, reverse, oblique

fields.name: other_structural_zones
fields.label: Other Structural Zones
fields.hint: deformation band; fracture, damage, alteration zones, domain boundary

fields.name: fold_type
fields.label: Fold Type
fields.hint: What is the shape of the fold when looking down-plunge?

fields.name: fold_attitude
fields.label: Fold Attitude
fields.hint: Orientation of fold: pluging, upright, overturned, etc.

fields.name: antropogenic_feature
fields.label: Antropogenic Feature
fields.hint: fence, property line, road, trail, other

fields.name: other_feature
fields.label: Other Feature
fields.hint: extent of mapping or biological marker

fields.name: trace_character
fields.label: Trace Character
fields.hint: sharp, gradational, chilled, brecciated, other

fields.name: label
fields.label: Label
fields.hint: If a label is not specified a default label will be given.

fields.name: Sample_IGSN
fields.label: Sample IGSN
fields.hint: Use the IGSN or International Generic Sample Number.  These are unique identifiers given out at igsn.org or obtained under you project at strabospot.org.

fields.name: eruption_start_datetime_utc
fields.label: Start Date/Time (UTC)
fields.hint: Use the pattern yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ

fields.name: eruption_end_datetime_utc
fields.label: End Date/Time (UTC)
fields.hint: Use the pattern yyyy-mm-ddThh:mm:ssZ

fields.name: weather_conditions
fields.label: Describe weather conditions during tephra fall
